text:
Ivy (PMM): quick 24h sprint to lock the battlecard + inbound routing variants for next webinar. Key: probe-proof claims vs cloud providers and infra vendors, plus gating rules for the benchmark deck.
Drew (Growth): we need two headline hooks and one short social blurb. also want tracking keys for opener variant.
Samir (Field): reps need 3 ultra-short one-liners (latency, cost, migration) and a 2-line SDR micro-play for benchmark leads.
Nora (Bench): topline bench notes (gated): p95 ~120ms at sustained 1k RPS in our harness; batching + prefix cache = ~3x token improvement on multi-turn; fallback policy preserved throughput in node-loss test. Public phrasing should be "customer-observed".
June (Content): will create public-safe copy + a sharper internal line per claim. Public: "Customer-observed p95 ~120ms under sustained load"; internal adds "ask for the benchmark deck" CTA.
Theo (Sales Ops): routing variants:
- Variant 1 (conservative): if lead.company_size > 800 OR lead.budget_est > 200k => AE; else SDR. Tag: bench_warm if clicked benchmark slide.
- Variant 2 (aggressive): any webinar attendee who watches >50% OR clicks benchmark slide => AE. Tag: bench_hot.
Pick one for the first week, we'll A/B by cohort.
Drew (Growth): run headline A in paid social, B in nurture emails. Headline A: "Stabilize LLM latency and lower token spend". Headline B: "Why managed endpoints fail tail-latency tests". Social blurb: "Predictable latency. Lower token cost. See the benchmark."
Samir (Field): SDR micro-play (2 lines):
- Opener: "We ran a production harness and saw p95 ~120ms; can I send the benchmark deck?"
- Close: "If they ask price: 'Most customers see 2-4x token efficiency on chat after batching; request the appendix.'"
June (Content): 6 quick rebuttals, short versions:
- "Why not use cloud endpoints?" -> "They don't provide tail protection or deterministic routing policies; we do."
- "Is owning the model enough?" -> "Serving defines latency/cost; ownership alone isn't sufficient."
- "What about migrations?" -> "Same API surface across modes; prompts port without infra rewrite."
Nora (Bench): deliverable: 2-slide benchmark summary + gated appendix (due 4100001400). I'll include anonymized prompt example.
June (Content): deliverable: 1-page internal battlecard + 6 rebuttals + 3 demo soundbites (due 4100001500). Public post draft due 4100001550.
Theo (Sales Ops): deliverable: implement routing Variant 1 OR 2 and create SFDC tags + AE task automation (due 4100001580). Add experiment key = webinar_routing_v2.
automation-bot: assets uploaded to s3://redwood-assets/marketing/webinar-410000/bench-summary.pdf at 4100001355
Ivy (PMM): decision: start with Variant 1 for wave A and Variant 2 for a high-intent wave B. Growth wire cohorts. Keep public language conservative; field gets the numbers and "ask for deck" CTA. Check-in in 6h in this thread. :rocket:
